name: cadencz
description: Plan, write and schedule social media posts for your business, grounded in what Cadencz knows about it.

interface.longDescription: Cadencz is a social media manager for founders and small teams: it plans, writes and schedules social media posts for your business. Connect your Cadencz account and ask ChatGPT to plan your week of posts, draft a post for LinkedIn, X, Threads, Bluesky and more, show this week's content plan, or check how much of your plan you have used. Every post is grounded in what Cadencz learned about your business from your website and written in your own voice. Drafts are saved to your Cadencz workspace for review; nothing is published or scheduled without your confirmation.
defaultPrompt: What does Cadencz know about my business?
Plan my social posts for this week.
Write a LinkedIn post about our newest feature.

positive.description: Ask what Cadencz knows about the signed-in user's business
positive.prompt: What does Cadencz know about my business?
positive.expected_behavior: A summary of the business from the Cadencz Brain (learned from the website during onboarding): what the product does, who it is for, and how it is positioned. Read-only; nothing is created or changed.

positive.description: Draft one LinkedIn post grounded in the business
positive.prompt: Write a LinkedIn post about the main benefit of my product.
positive.expected_behavior: One LinkedIn-ready post about the business, written in the account's voice and returned in the reply. It is saved as a draft in the Cadencz workspace; nothing is scheduled or published.

positive.description: Plan the week's social media posts
positive.prompt: Plan my social media posts for this week.
positive.expected_behavior: Cadencz writes a batch of draft posts for the week, each with a theme, platform and day, and summarises them in the reply. The drafts wait for review in Cadencz → Plan my week; nothing is scheduled or published.

positive.prompt: Show me this week's content plan.
positive.expected_behavior: This week's planned posts, each with its theme, platform, day and status (draft or approved). Read-only.

positive.description: Check how much of the plan's allowance is used
positive.prompt: How much of my Cadencz plan have I used this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Posts written, AI generations used, and what is left in the current period. Read-only.

negative.description: General social media question that is not about the user's own Cadencz account
negative.prompt: What is the character limit for a post on X and on LinkedIn?

negative.description: Question about someone else's public social media account, which Cadencz has no access to
negative.prompt: How many followers does Elon Musk have on X?

negative.description: Scheduling a calendar meeting, not a social media post
negative.prompt: Schedule a meeting with my team for Monday at 10am.

publication.release_notes: First release of Cadencz in ChatGPT. Sign in with your Cadencz account and ask ChatGPT what Cadencz knows about your business, draft a post for LinkedIn, X, Threads or Bluesky, plan your week of posts, review this week's plan, and check how much of your plan you have used. Drafts are saved to your Cadencz workspace for review; nothing is published without your confirmation.
